description_a: The hostel wifi in rooms on the third floor drops every few minutes, so video calls and downloads keep failing.
title_b: net bahut slow aur disconnect ho raha
description_b: third floor ke rooms me wifi baar baar disconnect ho jata hai, online class bhi attend nahi kar paate. please fix it soon.

description_a: The tap in the first floor washroom of Block A drips all night and the sound disturbs the nearby rooms.
description_b: The tap in the first floor washroom of Block C drips continuously. Please send a plumber to Block C.

description_a: The rice served at lunch today was hard and not cooked properly. Several students left it on their plates.
description_b: aaj lunch me chawal poora pakka nahi tha, bahut hard tha. kaafi log ne plate me chhod diya.

description_a: The water cooler on the 2nd floor of Wing A has been giving lukewarm water since Monday. Students keep complaining but nothing has changed.
description_b: The cooler on the 2nd floor of Wing A leaks water onto the floor all day. The water is cold, but it is a slip hazard.

description_a: The drain in the common bathroom on the first floor is blocked and water stays on the floor after every shower.
title_b: paani nahi nikal raha washroom me
description_b: first floor ke common bathroom me nali jam hai, nahane ke baad paani floor par bhar jata hai. smell bhi aa rahi hai.

title_a: cannot log in to course portal
description_a: The course portal shows an invalid credentials message even though my password is correct. I tried on two browsers.
description_b: I can log in to the course portal without any problem, but my quiz marks have not been updated for three weeks.

description_a: The department printer prints very faint pages and the paper comes out with white streaks. It has been like this since Tuesday.
description_b: Pages from the lab printer look light and streaky, so assignments are not readable. Nobody has replaced the cartridge.

description_a: The fan in room 214 rattles loudly at medium and high speed and I cannot sleep at night.
description_b: The regulator knob in my room is broken, so the fan only runs at full speed and there is no way to slow it down.

title_a: socket not working near study table
description_a: The switch board near my study table has no power, so I cannot charge my laptop. The other sockets in the room work.
description_b: The plug point beside the desk gives no electricity at all. Only the one near the bed is working, which is not enough.

description_a: The projector in room 301 shows a blue screen and does not display the laptop. Our lecture was delayed by twenty minutes.
description_b: The projector in the main auditorium works, but the image is so dim that slides cannot be read from the back rows.

description_a: The bread given with breakfast today was dry and had a sour smell. A few of us decided not to eat it.
description_b: subah ka bread purana lag raha tha aur smell kharab thi. hum ne khaya nahi aur manager ko bataya bhi.

description_a: I was billed forty rupees more than the menu price for a sandwich and the cashier did not correct it until I showed the board.
title_b: card machine not working at counter
description_b: The swipe machine at the cafeteria has been down since lunch, so students without cash cannot buy anything.

description_a: The lift in the main block stopped between the second and third floor for about ten minutes with people inside.
description_b: Today evening the lift froze between floors and a few students were trapped until the guard opened it. Please inspect it.

description_a: The attendance application closes by itself right after the splash screen, so I could not mark attendance in two classes.
description_b: The attendance app showed me absent for two lectures I attended. The professor confirmed that I was in class.

description_a: Music from a room on the ground floor continued until two in the morning on Saturday, even after we asked them to lower it.
description_b: ground floor ke ek room se raat ko do baje tak loud music chalta raha. bolne par bhi band nahi kiya.

description_a: I have not received any mail on my institute id for three days though friends confirm they sent attachments.
description_b: My institute inbox is full of promotional mails every hour, and important messages get buried under them.

description_a: There was a dead fly in my bowl of dal at dinner. I showed it to the server but he just took the bowl away.
description_b: dinner me meri dal ki katori me ek makhi thi. maine server ko dikhaya, usne bas katori hata di.

title_a: water leaking from ceiling in corridor
description_a: After the rain the ceiling of the corridor on the fourth floor leaks and a puddle forms near the stairs.
description_b: Rainwater drips onto my bed from the ceiling of my room on the first floor. The corridor outside is completely dry.

title_a: very long wait for food at night
description_a: At dinner the queue takes forty minutes because only one counter is open. Many students skip the meal.
title_b: only one counter open, huge line
description_b: raat ke khane me bahut line hoti hai kyunki sirf ek counter khula hai. kaafi der wait karna padta hai.

description_a: The computers in lab 2 take almost five minutes to open the code editor, which wastes our practical time.
description_b: Four systems in lab 2 have no keyboard or mouse, so we have to share computers during practicals.

description_a: There has been no hot water in the third floor bathroom since Sunday morning. Students are taking cold baths in this weather.
description_b: Hot water is not available in the third floor bathroom since Sunday morning. Students have to take cold baths in this weather.

description_a: The curry served at lunch was very oily and heavy, and several students felt uneasy afterwards.
description_b: The library closes at eight in the evening, which is too early for students preparing for exams.

description_a: The chapati served at dinner was very hard and chewy, and most students could not eat it.
description_b: Chapati served at dinner today was very hard and difficult to chew, so many students left it.

description_a: The bus stop outside the campus has no roof, so students get wet while waiting in the rain.
description_b: The spoons in the mess are rusty and bent, and some students refused to use them.

description_a: The air conditioner in the library reading hall is not working and the room becomes very hot in the afternoon.
description_b: The AC in the library reading hall does not work and it gets extremely hot in the afternoon.

description_a: The campus gym is closed every Sunday, which is the only day many students have free time.
description_b: The mattress in my room is torn and the springs are visible, which makes it painful to sleep.

description_a: The treadmill in the campus gym stops after two minutes and shows an error message. It has been unusable for a week.
description_b: The treadmill in the campus gym stops working after a couple of minutes with an error on the screen. Nobody can use it for a week now.

description_a: There is no space to park bicycles near the academic block, so they are left on the footpath.
description_b: The tea served at the evening canteen is lukewarm and watery most days.

title_a: college bus arriving late every morning
description_a: The morning college bus from the station arrives thirty minutes late almost every day, so we miss the first lecture.
description_b: The college bus from the station comes about thirty minutes late nearly every morning and we miss the first lecture.

description_a: The sports room does not have enough badminton rackets, so students wait a long time for a turn.
description_b: There is no wifi signal on the first floor of the library, so we cannot download study material.

title_a: corridor lights not working at night
description_a: The tube lights in the second floor corridor are off at night, so it is dark and unsafe near the stairs.
description_b: The tube lights in the second floor corridor do not work at night, so the stairs area is dark and unsafe.

title_a: water bottles overpriced at campus shop
description_a: Water bottles at the campus shop are sold above the printed price, and the shopkeeper refuses a bill.
description_b: The notice board in the main building still shows last semester's timetable and exam dates.

title_a: washing machine not working in laundry room
description_a: The washing machine in the hostel laundry room stops in the middle of the cycle and leaves clothes soaked.
title_b: laundry room washing machine stops midway
description_b: The washing machine in the laundry room stops midway through the cycle, leaving the clothes full of water.

description_a: The hostel gate is locked at ten at night, so students returning from the library are stuck outside.
description_b: The microphone in the seminar hall makes a loud buzzing sound during every presentation.

description_a: The football ground stays full of water for two days after any rain, so the team cannot practise.
description_b: After rain the football ground remains flooded for two days and practice sessions have to be cancelled.

description_a: There are too many mosquitoes in the ground floor rooms in the evenings and nobody does fogging.
description_b: The online course feedback form shows an error page when I press submit, so I could not give feedback.

title_a: ID card not scanning at main gate
description_a: The ID card reader at the main gate does not scan my card, so the guard makes me wait and write an entry.
title_b: main gate card reader not scanning
description_b: The card reader at the main gate fails to scan my ID card and the guard has to make a manual entry each time.

description_a: The dustbins outside the canteen are full and overflowing, and there is a bad smell all around.
description_b: Several chairs in the classroom on the second floor are broken, and some students have to stand.

description_a: The overhead water tank behind the hostel overflows every morning and wastes water on the road.
description_b: Every morning the overhead tank behind the hostel overflows and the water runs onto the road.

description_a: The road between the hostel and the academic block has deep potholes that are dangerous for cyclists.
description_b: I applied for a replacement ID card three weeks ago and have not received it.
